4. Please give reasons for the choice of methodologies used, why choose the two-stage PCA
method rather than the entropy weighting method to construct the Financial Inclusion Index?

Thank you very much for dedicating your time and effort to reviewing our work, particularly
for your prompt review report. Your insightful comments will undoubtedly enhance the
quality of our manuscript. We have taken your comments to heart and will carefully address
each of the five main points you raised in the revised version of this article. We look forward
to your thoughts on the revisions we have made.

Response: Thank you this valuable comment. We have provided a rationale for choosing the
two-stage PCA method over alternatives, such as the entropy weighting and CFA method,
for constructing the financial inclusion index.
